powersave.description:
While sound flows into an AirPlay speaker, turn the Wi-Fi radio's power save OFF (it sleeps between beacons, and the stream drops
out) and put it back after. Needs the silicon helper's `wifi-powersave` verb and its polkit rule (`lares setup`, R3 and R4); without
them nothing is changed and the log says so once. A power save that was already off when sound started is yours: never touched.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

graceSec.description:
Seconds after the last sound before power save is put back (a track change or a pause is not the end). 0 .. 3600.

Takes a number 0 .. 3600. Default: 60.

delay.description:
How long the SOUND lags what the player knows, in ms: the track card (OSD), the bar glyph's new-song flourish and the lyrics'
active line wait this long, only while mpd plays into an AirPlay speaker.
  "auto"  the speaker's own buffer, read from the PipeWire module that made it: raop.latency.ms + sess.latency.msec
          (~/.config/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/raop-discover.conf)
  number  that many ms instead (0 .. 60000; 0 = never wait)

Takes "auto", or a number 0 .. 60000. Default: "auto".

delayExtraMs.description:
Added to either (can be negative; the total never goes below 0): the speaker's buffer is not always the whole of what you hear.

Takes a number -60000 .. 60000. Default: 0.
